author: Apostle Shemmy Gaviyao

scripture.text: For by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; it is the gift of God.

teaching:
Grace is one of the greatest revelations of the New Covenant. It reveals the heart of God toward humanity and shows us that everything we receive from God is based on the finished work of Jesus Christ and not human effort. Grace is not merely God's forgiveness toward our failures; it is God's divine ability working within the believer to fulfill His eternal purpose.

Through Christ, we have received a new identity. We are no longer defined by our past, our weaknesses, or our natural limitations. The believer stands accepted before God because of the perfect work of Jesus Christ. Grace empowers us to walk in faith, righteousness, and victory as sons and daughters of God.
goldenNugget: Grace does not empower you to earn God's acceptance; grace reveals that you are already accepted in Christ.
prayer: Father, I thank You for Your grace that has freely made me alive in Christ. I receive Your divine ability working within me today. I walk in the reality of my identity, righteousness, and purpose in Christ Jesus. Amen.
